_comment: Protocol section 0: every result directory is classified active | superseded | diagnostic. Generated tables must never mix categories. Machine-readable so the check is enforceable rather than a convention.

_categories.active: Current evidence. May appear in paper tables.
_categories.superseded: Replaced by a later measurement. Must not appear in paper tables except as an explicitly labelled contrast.
_categories.diagnostic: Instrumented or exploratory runs. Interpretable only as a cost decomposition or debugging aid, never as wall-clock.

m5.note: Final factorial, n=1 per cell; combine with m5-rep for n=3.

m5-rep.note: Repeats r2/r3 of every factorial cell.

m5-timing.note: profile_timing=true. Cost decomposition only; absolute ms inflated by timers.

m3.note: Matched training arms, scaling curves, held-out CE.

m1.note: Benchmark matrix n=3. Pre-thread-cap: static path ~2% conservative.

m4.note: TIMINGS contaminated by uncapped host threads. Acceptance columns remain valid.

bench.note: Pod-A single runs. RQ2 conclusion did not reproduce; several runs under concurrent GPU use.

rq1.note: Budget x allocation grid; acceptance only.

rq3.note: Historical loop ladder, pod A, earlier drafter.

e1.note: E1 correctness. float32 free-running EXACT (52,224/52,224); bf16 fidelity and same-prefix margins. Frozen test split.

e2.note: E2 timing replication, sessions s1/s2/s3, per-prompt rows with paired AR. Both completed sessions passed the drift audit.

e4.note: E4 host thread sensitivity. sweep-* and stageB-* cells are ACTIVE (timers off, clean latency; stageB-* are five repeats per cap at 8/32/208 threads on the test prompts, analysed by scripts/make_fact_tables.py); attrib-* cells are DIAGNOSTIC (profile_timing=true, inflated absolutes) and e4_analyze.py reads only sweep-*, so the two are never mixed in a table.

e8.note: E8 sampling profile, profile_timing=true. Cost attribution only; absolute values inflated by the timers.

e1q.note: E1 procedure D (Gate A): paired downstream quality for the bf16 headline system, HumanEval pass@1 and GSM8K exact match, n=60 each. A differencing instrument: absolute scores are harness-limited and are not capability numbers.

e5.note: E5 seed replication (Gate E): seven arms, arm-independent held-out rollout CE plus MT-Bench/HumanEval acceptance on the frozen test split. Seeds 1-2 feed Table rq2's replication panel; e5-tf-s0 is the feature-equivalence check against the archived seed-0 run.

e6.note: Intended as a 20k->30k continuation but trained from random init: chainD copied the 20k checkpoint to resume_from_20k.pt, which the trainer never loads. Valid only as a 0-10k learning curve for the step-decayed objective; not evidence about training beyond 20k.

campaign-logs.note: Chain, watcher and sync logs from the E1-E8 pod campaign, 2026-09-03 to 2026-09-11.

known_scope_limits.precision: All reported speed is bfloat16 and greedy. Exact equivalence verified at float32; bf16 shows near-tie argmax flips (pilot: 88.4% position agreement).
known_scope_limits.prompt_split: Pre-protocol results used eval.prompt_split=legacy (first-n), which is NOT a dev/test separation: the scaled drafter, the recommended configuration and the thread cap were all selected on those prompts. Protocol results (e1/e2/e4/e8) use the frozen disjoint split, so they are not directly comparable to the earlier campaign by design.
known_scope_limits.sampling: Speed claims are greedy-only. Temperature-1.0 sampling measures 0.16x.
known_scope_limits.features: The 788 GB feature store was lost with the pod-B volume on 2026-09-03. Checkpoints, results and logs were all recovered beforehand. Re-extraction is ~20 H100-hours and is only needed for E5/E6/E9.
known_scope_limits.verifier_source: Protocol results use NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct, verified bit-identical to meta-llama on all four weight shards by LFS SHA-256 and byte size. Our own gated access was pending at the time of the runs.
